manifest.name: Monochrome
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: A clean grayscale theme with sharp contrasts and no color distractions

css: :root { --bg-primary: #f5f5f5; --bg-secondary: #e0e0e0; --bg-card: #ffffff; --text-primary: #1a1a1a; --text-secondary: #666666; --accent: #333333; --accent-hover: #000000; --border-color: #cccccc; --shadow-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } body { background-color: var(--bg-primary) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } .card, .card-item { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px var(--shadow-color) !important; } .card-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent) !important; } header, .header { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; } button { border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; } button:hover { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; } .modal-content, .menu-section { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } input, textarea, select { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent) !important; } .tag { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; } .breadcrumb a, a { color: var(--accent) !important; } .toast { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent) !important; }
